$comment: EVERY LINK AND EVERY PRODUCT LABEL IN THE WELCOME EMAIL, AND WHAT IS BEHIND IT.
A link must never point at a destination that does not exist. `targets` carry a
classification and build.mjs refuses a D:
A  Directly deep-linkable: the path is in web/deep-links.config.json appPaths, an
Expo Router screen receives it, and web/build.mjs publishes a fallback page.
C  Per recipient: the send job fills it from that account's own data.
`labels` are product names the letter tells the reader to find. email.test.mjs reads
each file and fails if the label is no longer rendered there.

inviteLink.capability: The recipient's own personal invite link. Redeeming it connects the two people: both follow edges approved, whatever either account's privacy (20260912000200_an_invitation_is_a_connection_on_both_sides.sql).
inviteLink.deepLink: /i/* is in appPaths and app/i/[token].tsx receives it. It is the exact URL the app shares: use-recommend.ts builds `https://bingd.app/i/${token}` from create_invite_link's token.
inviteLink.webFallback: web/dist/i.html: the invitation page with the install row and 'I already have bingd.'.
inviteLink.userData: invite_tokens.token for the recipient: live, kind personal, minted in this environment, which is what redeem_invite accepts. Returned by the claim from _welcome_email_ensure_invite_token.
inviteLink.noToken: Tokens are minted lazily, so many new accounts have none. The claim mints the one personal link under create_invite_link's own lock, with no invite_link_creations row and no other side effect. README.md, 'The invite link'.

founderProfile.capability: The founder's public profile, with Follow in its action row. Following a public account is approved at once.
founderProfile.deepLink: /u/* is in appPaths; app/u/[username].tsx renders the profile and FollowControl.
founderProfile.webFallback: web/dist/u.html resolves the display name and avatar and offers the install row plus Open in bingd.
founderProfile.verified: 2026-09-11 against production: the handle resolves and the account is public. 2026-09-13: route and fallback unchanged on main; https://bingd.app/u/saisurajkan answers 200.

labels.label: Group Picks
labels.note: The chip that opens GroupPicksSheet. Nothing in the app is called Group Watch.

mintAtSendTime.why: Minting a personal token for an account that has none would mean a service-role writer around create_invite_link, which is SECURITY DEFINER over auth.uid() and records an invite_link_creations row per share. Doing it for an email changes what that row means. It is one of the options in README.md, not something the send job does.
